text: Setting clear goals is essential for any successful project. One popular method is using SMART goals, which means goals that are Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. It also helps to break a big project into smaller steps called milestones. These allow you to check your progress along the way. You should also define your deliverables — the actual results or products you will hand over at the end. Finally, make sure all stakeholders agree on the goals from the start. When everyone shares the same understanding, the project is much more likely to succeed.
